title: factdiff.py anchor --file --refetch does not refetch a gone anchor row inside its 7-day backoff
goal: anchor --file F --refetch fetches the source of each gone row of F's facts whatever its age, as kb/_self/tools.md says --refetch ignores the cache, while a run without --refetch keeps the 7-day backoff of ST-yb5x4x3d. Found by the SP-b36246xo review (S4).
